scenario: LUNI.8.7.2 — `::Float` also unblocks a cross-dim compare. `p.temp > p.mass::Float` strips the mass tag so the compare sees temperature on the left and a unitless Float on the right; LUNI.8.2's cross-dim check doesn't fire because one side has no dim. Pin: `::Float` is the documented LUNI.8.4 unit-strip escape hatch.
rules_ds:
schema Probe scope logical:
    temp: kelvin key
    mass: kilogram mutable

rule odd:
    Probe p where p.temp > p.mass::Float
->
    log info "raw float compare"
